title.en: An Act Converting the Currimao Health Center in Barangay Poblacion Uno, Municipality of Currimao, Province of Ilocos Norte, Into A Five-bed Capacity Health Infirmary, To Be Known As the Currimao Health Infirmary, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Currimao Health Center in Barangay Poblacion Uno, Municipality of Currimao, Province of Ilocos Norte, Into A Five-bed Capacity Health Infirmary, To Be Known As the Currimao Health Infirmary, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Trung tâm Y tế Currimao tại Barangay Poblacion Uno, Đô thị Currimao, Tỉnh Ilocos Norte thành Bệnh xá Currimao, và phân bổ kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะศูนย์สุขภาพ Currimao ในบารังไกย์ Poblacion Uno เทศบาล Currimao จังหวัด Ilocos Norte เป็นสถานีอนามัย Currimao และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah status Pusat Kesehatan Currimao di Barangay Poblacion Uno, Kotamadya Currimao, Provinsi Ilocos Norte menjadi Infirmari Kesehatan Currimao, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pusat Kesihatan Currimao di Barangay Poblacion Uno, Perbandaran Currimao, Wilayah Ilocos Norte kepada Infirmari Kesihatan Currimao, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: The Currimao Health Center in Barangay Poblacion Uno, Municipality of Currimao, Province of Ilocos Norte, is hereby converted into a five-bed capacity health infirmary, to be known as the Currimao Health Infirmary.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
